name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: The platform's own select, styled as SelectTrigger: for long lists, dense grids of many selects, and phones.
docs: NativeSelect shares SelectTrigger's tokens, height, radius, focus ring, hover, press, disabled and invalid states, and its chevron. Choose it over Select for a long list, a dense grid of many selects such as one per table row, or a phone, where the system picker serves better: a native select changes nothing on <body> when it opens, while a Radix Select makes the browser restyle the whole page on every choice. className and style land on the wrapper that holds the chevron; every other prop and the ref reach the <select>. See DESIGN.md "Choosing a select".
